F.data_reference: definitional; Faraday constant, SN_simple's rounding of the CODATA 2018 exact value 96485.33212 C/mol

T.data_reference: davis2021transcriptomic; Methods (Ch. 2): "All recordings were performed at room temperature" (value not stated; 22 degC assumed); p. 215: neurons died above 30 degC

E_Na.data_reference: definitional; Nernst potential RT/F ln(Nao/Nai) at Nao 145, Nai 13 mM, 295.15 K (used when unconnected)

V.data_reference: definitional; clamp value when unconnected: the SN resting potential (-70 mV, cf. davis2020downregulation)

V_den_h.data_reference: tao2011model; Supporting Material (Document S1) Eq. 87 (k = 6.5 mV); modified here to 4 mV (was 6.5)

V_den_m.data_reference: tao2011model; Supporting Material (Document S1) Eq. 86 (k = 7.2 mV); modified here to 6 mV (was 7.2)

V_mid_h.data_reference: tao2011model; Supporting Material (Document S1) Eq. 87 (h_inf V1/2 = -53.2 mV, k = 6.5 mV); modified here to 40 mV (was 53.2)

V_mid_m.data_reference: tao2011model; Supporting Material (Document S1) Eq. 86 (Belluzzi-Sacchi I_Na m_inf V1/2 = -36 mV, k = 7.2 mV); modified here to 20 mV (was 36)

V_rest_approx.data_reference: davis2020downregulation; resting membrane potential of rat stellate neurons: Wistar -72.6 +- 1.0 mV (Fig. 4C), SHR -70.3 +- 1.4 mV (Fig. 5D); -70 mV approximates it (the CA token cites davis2021transcriptomic, whose current-clamp traces the value was read from)

A_mem.data_reference: definitional; the soma membrane area 3000 um^2 (used when unconnected; in a soma it comes from the membrane through the membrane_area port)

rho_Na.data_reference: definitional; chosen so that g_Na = A rho gamma_Na reproduces the previous g_Na 2.3 uS at A 3000 um^2. For calibration: keynes1971binding measured 75 channels/um^2 (TTX binding, rabbit vagus C fibres; an axonal density)

gamma_Na.data_reference: magee1995characterization; TTX-sensitive single Na channel conductance 15 +- 0.3 pS in rat CA1 neurons, cell-attached (Abstract, point 2); cf. Sigworth & Neher 1980 ~18 pS in rat muscle

tau_h_max.data_reference: owner's hand-set value (CA_user 70f2cf7, 2025-05-04: reset from 300 to 5 ms when the slow component was moved to i_Na1_6; CA token 'user_defined'). Cf. belluzzi1986quantitative Fig. 9B: tau_h bell-shaped, peak ~22 ms near -50 mV at 37 degC (46.1 ms at -50 mV, 2.5 ms at -100 mV at 27 degC, p. 282); = tao2011model Document S1 Eq. 89 (peak ~23-42 ms near -46 mV); here ~4x faster

tau_h_min.data_reference: owner's hand-set floor (CA_user ad0ce77, 2024-07-21; CA token 'user_defined'). Cf. belluzzi1986quantitative Fig. 8A: tau_h 0.987 ms at -20 mV, 27 degC (~0.42 ms at 37 degC with Q10 2.37, Table 2); tao2011model Eq. 89 gives ~0.1-0.26 ms at 0 to +40 mV

Q10_m_Na.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; conventional gating Q10 (no effect while T_ref = T); belluzzi1986quantitative Table 2 also gives a measured tau_m Q10 (17-27 degC), not re-read

Q10_h_Na.data_reference: belluzzi1986quantitative; Table 2: temperature coefficient of tau_h Q10 = 2.37 (rat sympathetic neurone Na current, 17-27 degC; used there to reconstruct the 37 degC kinetics)

T_ref_Na.data_reference: definitional; equal to the model temperature, so kinetics are unscaled; to be set to the source's recording temperature on review
